titre: Commerce de détail de la zone euro
sous_titre: Volume, variation annuelle moyenne en %, 2023 à 2025

series.nom: Zone euro, volume du commerce de détail

2023.texte: The annual average level of retail trade for the year 2023, compared with 2022, decreased by 1.8%

2024.texte: The annual average level of retail trade volume for the year 2024, compared with 2023, increased by 1.0% in the euro area
